# Akademate

> Academy management software for enrolment, timetables, campus, payments and operations.

Akademate is a product of Brik64 LLC, doing business as Brik64 Inc.
Public contact: info@akademate.com

Akademate is an operating system for academies: in-person, online and hybrid centres in one workspace.
